description: Bird sanctuary Rijskampen, May 2024, the south of the Netherlands Skylark prominent in the ambiance. Birds detected with Merlin Bird ID app in this track; #0:00 Western Yellow Wagtail #0:09 Meadow Pipit #0:10 Eurasian Coot #0:14 Eurasian Skylark #0:24 #0:59 European Stonechat #0:25 Northern Lapwing #1:33 Mediterranean Gull #1:48 Greylag Goose #1:51 Canada Goose #2:03 Common Cuckoo In the background the frogs. (All Birds detected with Merlin Bird ID app this hole morning; Bank Swallow, Canada Goose, Carrion Crow, Common Cuckoo, Common Quail, Common Swift, Eurasian Coot, Eurasian Curlew, Eurasian Jackdaw, Eurasian Skylark, European Starling, European Stonechat, Gray Heron, Lesser Black-backed Gull, Meadow Pipit, Northern Lapwing, Red Bunting, Western Yellow Wagtail) This bird sanctuary De Rijskampen is part of a vast “Gement” polder between village Vlijmen, city 's-Hertogenbosch and Vught in the province of Noord-Brabant in the Netherlands. It has been transformed into an inundation area for the Maas, Aa, Dommel and Dieze rivers that surround the city. This adjustment was made after the flooding of the A2 motorway in 1995. It should not have gone further or there would have been three meters of water in my home. The entire Bommelerwaard, to the north of this area, with 250,000 people, between the river Maas and Waal, was evacuated. Yes, yes, the Netherlands waterland, but not too much please. Enough nagging; listen and enjoy. More here today / More here during the years Date/time: May 19st Sunday 2024, start 10.12 AM Weather: 17-18c, some thin high clouds 50%, wind WNW 7 km/h -op to 25 km/ht, 1020 hPa, hum 69%. visibility 24 km, humidity 80-75, dew point 14c, Mic pointed W 264 degree Location; Bird sanctuary Rijskampen, Gement Polder, natuurgebied Rijskampen, Honderdmorgensedijk ,Vught - ‘s-Hertogenbosch (Den Bosch), Van Gogh Nationaal Park, Noord-Brabant, Netherlands (Holland), Europe.
